scope: Signal-to-coordinate mapping only; not differentiable contacts, mesh pose or end-to-end VLA training

design.numeric_mapping: Standalone piecewise-affine surrogate in scripts/archive/coordinate_mapping.mjs and scripts/archive/torch_coordinates.py; it is independent of the browser viewer and is not a measured Xbox transfer function.
design.input: floating tensor [...,21] with standard axes then button values
design.output: [...,J] coordinates in explicit configured channel order; inverse returns only J configured signals, never invented zeros for unknown channels
design.parameters: q0/q1 must be finite and explicitly provided with provenance; fixed buffers, not learnable physical parameters
design.non_smooth_points: Asymmetric stick zero has unequal one-sided derivatives; inverse clipping boundaries are nonsmooth and outside gradients are zero. Gradcheck samples interior points away from these boundaries.
design.numerical_safety: Inactive where branches use safe nonzero divisors so button q0=0 does not introduce NaN gradients.
design.runtime_limits: Validation performs tensor-to-Python checks and can synchronize GPU; no torch.compile or real-time throughput claim.

harness.reference_scope: 9 state vectors times all 21 channels, neutral/endpoints/intermediate values; synthetic parameters only
harness.gradient_scope: Batched [2,3,21] forward, inverse gradcheck in float64; composed upstream gradient; saturated zero gradient; float32 backward; malformed/null configuration rejection
harness.comparison_tolerance: atol=rtol=1e-12 for float64 cross-language coordinate comparison; numerical tolerance, not physical accuracy

result.environment: GPU node existing robotwin Python environment, torch 2.4.1+cu121, tests on CPU tensors
